test_title: PYST 27: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which Indian political leader is known for the 'Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra' campaign in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shivraj Singh Chouhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Viksit Bharat Sankalp Yatra** is a nationwide outreach initiative of the **Government of India** aimed at achieving **100% saturation** of flagship schemes across all **Gram Panchayats** and urban local bodies.
 
• **Shivraj Singh Chouhan**, as the **Union Minister of Rural Development** and **Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare** (appointed in **June 2024**), is a key leader responsible for the campaign's progress and rural outreach in **2024** and **2025**. ***Hence, this option is correct.***
 
• The Yatra was officially launched by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** on **November 15, 2023**, coinciding with **Janjatiya Gaurav Divas** from **Khunti, Jharkhand**.
 
• The primary function of the Yatra is to raise awareness and provide on-the-spot enrollment for welfare programs through specially designed **Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) vans**.
 
• Key schemes promoted during this campaign include **PM-Kisan**, **Ayushman Bharat**, **PM Ujjwala Yojana**, and **PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana**, ensuring that the benefits reach the **"last mile"** of the population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Viksit Bharat @2047:** This is a vision document and roadmap to transform India into a **developed nation** by the **100th year of Independence** in **2047**. The Yatra serves as a foundational step toward this long-term economic and social goal.
 
• **Janjatiya Gaurav Divas:** The campaign launch date, **November 15**, marks the birth anniversary of the legendary tribal leader **Birsa Munda**. This emphasizes the government's focus on **tribal development** and inclusion.
 
• **Scope and Data:** The Yatra targets coverage of over **2.6 lakh Gram Panchayats** and approximately **4,000 urban local bodies**, making it one of the largest ever government-to-citizen outreach programs in the country.
 
• **Digital Integration:** The campaign tracks real-time progress through a dedicated **portal and mobile app**, capturing data on the number of beneficiaries reached and testimonies (**"Meri Kahani Meri Zubani"**) shared by citizens.
 
• **Role of Government Departments:** Various ministries, including the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting** and the **Ministry of Rural Development**, collaborate to manage the logistics of the **mobile vans** and community interaction sessions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Rahul Gandhi:** He is a senior leader of the **Indian National Congress** known for leading the **Bharat Jodo Yatra** (2022–2023) and the **Bharat Jodo Nyay Yatra** (2024), which were opposition-led political marches. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***
 
• **Mallikarjun Kharge:** He currently serves as the **President of the Indian National Congress** and the **Leader of the Opposition** in the **Rajya Sabha**. His role is primarily focused on parliamentary and party leadership rather than government-led outreach campaigns like Viksit Bharat. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***
 
• **Yogi Adityanath:** He is the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**. While he has been instrumental in implementing the Yatra within **Uttar Pradesh**, he is not the national leader identified with the broader **2025** central ministerial oversight of the campaign. ***Hence, this option is incorrect.***
 
• **Target Beneficiaries:** The campaign specifically focuses on **women**, **farmers**, **youth**, and the **economically marginalized (Gareeb)**, often referred to as the **"four pillars"** of a developed India by the current administration.
